expectations.text: Recommends dropping the reflexive per-folder and big aggregator barrels in favour of direct path imports
expectations.evidence: 'Drop the big aggregator barrel'; 'delete any per-folder barrel that's just a passthrough' in favour of direct path imports

expectations.text: Grounds it in agent indirection: the barrel hides where a symbol lives, so the agent hops or guesses the shape
expectations.evidence: 'AI tools are remarkably reluctant to look at other files... it often won't, and works from a guess about the component's props'

expectations.text: Keeps a deliberate barrel only at a real public-API / package boundary (does NOT say delete all barrels)
expectations.evidence: 'Keep small, explicit, hand-written barrels for the few folders that are real modules with a public API'

expectations.text: Names at least one concrete secondary cost (circular imports, tree-shaking, or slow build/test startup)
expectations.evidence: Lists circular imports, tree-shaking/bundle bloat, slow cold starts and test runs
